$comment: Owner-controlled launch gate, enforced by POST /api/admin/demolition-fund/launch/prepare. Public addresses only; never put keys here. Changes go through a reviewed pull request.
launchWalletNote: PUBLIC address of the Phantom wallet that deploys $DYNASTY (and only $DYNASTY). Until set, the $DYNASTY launch is refused.
propertyLaunchWalletNote: PUBLIC address of the separate Phantom wallet that deploys the property coins (owner decision 2026-11-19: not the $DYNASTY wallet; the server refuses it if the two match). Until set, every property launch is refused. It needs its own lookup table, created from /admin/treasury while it is connected.
lookupTableNote: Optional record of the $DYNASTY wallet's lookup table (the page remembers each wallet's own table).
orderNote: 1) $DYNASTY. 2) ONE property coin listed in approvedProperties. 3) Verify its on-chain fee-sharing config and the accounting (fee-sharing check matching). 4) Run one controlled buyback-and-burn to BURNED. 5) Only then may further approved properties launch, one at a time.
approvedPropertiesNote: Slugs the owner explicitly approves for launch. Owner decision 2026-11-19: Jason's Stilt House is the first property coin. Empty = no property coin may launch.
